items.html: And when this Botsina strikes within the thought, it raises the clarifications from the aspect of the 325 sparks mentioned, and there they are clarified. And the good among them is corrected there, and the waste, which is the dross, is clarified and thrown away, for it is not of the aspect fit there to make from them the aspect of AVI; therefore it throws them, and it later returns to be clarified within the thought of Ima, for the need of ZON. And likewise in this manner, until the end of the clarification is clarified in all the Partzufim, and the rest becomes complete waste, as mentioned there at length. And this is what it said, "sparks, he threw to the 320 sides, and clarified the waste from within the thought." For within the thought the kings and sparks rise, and there they are clarified from within the thought, by that Botsina deKardinuta, which is the Gevura of Atik within it.
